note: Fictional brand and claims: a sample film to show the kit. Not a real company.

brand.name: VELMORA
brand.line: first café · opens 1 November · sample film

board.action: A drop of coffee falls onto the paper and blooms open into coffee hills at first light: ridges in mist, rows of shrubs heavy with cherries.
board.sound: The drop's tick; wind; far birds; one Rhodes chord.
board.why: Open on the motif (a circle) and the origin.

board.action: On one branch a cherry ripens from green to red, then lets go and falls right.
board.why: The bean's journey starts; its fall hands over to his first step.

board.action: A blue-hour street. His door swings open; the man in the ochre coat steps out and sets off left to right.
board.sound: Door latch; city; his footsteps begin, in time. Brushes enter.
board.in: Match on motion (the cherry falls right, he steps right)
board.why: Our protagonist, introduced in one action.

board.shot: MS → TOP · orbit, then a scale-step
board.action: The drum roaster turns and pours its beans into the cooling tray; the arms sweep them round.
board.sound: Drum hum and bean rattle; a soft air on the wipe.

board.action: He walks past the terraces; behind him the street lamps go out one by one as the sky warms; a vent breathes steam.
board.sound: Footsteps panning with him; a click as each lamp goes out; steam hiss.
board.in: Match (the tray's circle → the round lamps)
board.why: Time passes: night turns to morning.

board.action: Over the grinder's mouth, the crank turns; grounds fall into the bowl.
board.sound: The grinder's crunch, pulsing with the crank.

board.action: He turns into a side street. At the far end, VELMORA's sign flickers on.
board.sound: Steps slow; the sign's soft electric hum.

board.shot: WS → CU · push into the stream
board.action: A gooseneck kettle circles over the dripper: the stream arcs in, the bed blooms and bubbles, drips fill the carafe.
board.sound: The pour; drips; steam. The music is at its fullest.
board.in: Match (the sign's glow → the kettle's shine)
board.why: The two journeys are about to meet.

board.action: The café door opens on warm light. He steps in.
board.sound: Door; the shop bell. Then near-silence: one held chord.

board.action: From above, a rosetta draws itself into the crema.
board.sound: A reverse swell; the milk pour; café murmur.
board.why: They meet: the bean becomes his cup.

board.action: At the counter, he lifts the cup; steam curls up into the morning light.
board.sound: Café murmur; the cup leaves the saucer; the music lands.
board.in: Match (the cup from above → the cup on the counter)

board.action: The VELMORA wordmark; first café; opens 1 November.
board.sound: A last clink; the chord's tail.
board.why: The action, and the label: a fictional sample.

board.title: Two journeys, one cup
board.logline: A man walking to work and a coffee bean travelling from the hills cross the city before sunrise, and meet in one cup at Velmora's new café.
board.device: Parallel journeys: bean / man intercut, shots shortening as they converge, then one slow payoff.
board.motif: Circles and steam: the drop, the cherry, the drum, the tray, the lamps, the cup.
board.protagonist: A man in an ochre coat and a dark fedora, always walking left to right.
board.arc: A blue, sleepy city → the café's door opens on warm light → the first cup as the sun reaches the street.
